name: moldSourceBody
description: Name of the source body the mold is generated from; the intake stage resolves it in the named document.

name: moldUpAxis
description: Direction of the pour opening (rim up) in the source design.

name: clayShrinkagePct
description: Measured wet-to-fired linear shrinkage of the slip.

name: applyShrinkage
description: 1 if the Fusion model is at fired size and must be scaled up; 0 if already greenware size.

name: wareScale
description: Uniform scale applied to the ware only, never to mold or casing parameters.

name: castWallTarget
description: Intended cast wall; used for spare level-drop check and documentation.

name: spareStyle
description: Spare split with the side pieces, a separate plaster ring piece removed first, or a non-absorbent printed spout.

name: spareHeight
description: Height of the slip well above the rim; checked against max(15 mm, 2 x predicted drop + 5 mm).

name: spareStepOut
description: Outward step at rim height forming a flat plaster knife ledge (0 = straight extrusion of the rim).

name: spareFlareAngle
description: Outward flare of the spare walls for release.

name: spareTopRound
description: Round on the plaster edge at the top of the well.

name: plasterWall
description: Nominal plaster offset from the cast plug (30-40 mm for 150-300 mm ware).

name: plasterBase
description: Plaster thickness under the foot (bottom piece).

name: plasterEdgeChamfer
description: Chamfer on outer plaster edges.

name: plasterWallWarnRatio
description: Warn where local plaster thickness is below this fraction of plasterWall.

name: plasterWallFailRatio
description: Fail where local plaster thickness is below this fraction of plasterWall.

name: plasterWallMinAbs
description: Absolute minimum local plaster thickness.

name: plasterConsistency
description: Water parts per 100 plaster by weight (USG No. 1); brand-specific.

name: plasterDryPerCm3
description: Dry plaster mass per cm3 of plaster body at consistency 70.

name: plasterOveragePct
description: Extra plaster mixed for spills and leaks.

name: wetPieceWeightWarn
description: Warn when a wet plaster piece (V x 1.58 g/cm3) exceeds this.

name: moldLayout
default: 'auto' (text: auto | dropOut | sides2 | sides2Bottom | sides3Bottom | sides4Bottom)
description: Piece layout; auto picks the simplest zero-undercut layout and asks for approval.

name: sidePieceCount
description: Number of side sectors when the layout is set manually.

name: splitAzimuth
description: Azimuth of the first axial split plane (irrelevant for pure revolves; set for handles or bed fit).

name: bottomSplitMargin
description: Margin above the highest annular slice (foot recess) for the bottom/side split.

name: bottomSplitHeightOverride
description: Manual bottom split height above the foot plane.

name: allowDropOut
description: Allow a one-piece drop-out mold when the profile permits.

name: maxPlasterPieces
description: Hard cap on plaster pieces; beyond it the toolkit reports and stops.

name: disassemblyOrder
description: Planned opening order; verified collision-free including natches.

name: undercutTolDeg
description: Numerical tolerance: fail if n.d < -sin(undercutTolDeg) or occluded.

name: draftWarnDeg
description: Warn on cast-contact faces with less draft than this.

name: coreDraftMinDeg
description: Minimum draft on convex plaster cores the cast shrinks onto.

name: analysisDirStepDeg
description: Angular step of horizontal candidate pull directions.

name: analysisTargetTriangles
description: Target mesh size for pure-Python analysis (keeps each call well under 30 s).

name: analysisSurfaceTol
description: TriangleMeshCalculator surface tolerance for analysis meshes.

name: natchStyle
description: Registration key type.

name: natchRadius
description: Sphere radius of the cap key.

name: natchDepth
description: Cap depth (about 0.58 x radius gives about 25 deg rim draft).

name: natchClearance
description: Radial play between plaster bump and socket formed by independent casings; calibrate by coupon (0.1 mm for printed inserts).

name: natchesPerSeam
description: Keys per seam, asymmetric layout.

name: natchesShortSeam
description: Keys on seams shorter than 100 mm.

name: natchEdgeMargin
description: Minimum distance from key footprint to cavity edge and to the chamfered outer edge.

name: natchAsymmetric
description: Offset key positions so pieces cannot be assembled the wrong way round.

name: casingStrategy
description: Split, flanged and clamped casings, or thin one-piece shells peeled with a heat gun.

name: casingWorkflow
description: Pour each piece in its own casing, or use a soaped finished piece as the wall for the next.

name: casingWall
description: Reusable casing wall (replaces printedMoldWallThickness = 5 mm).

name: casingWallSacrificial
description: Sacrificial shell wall (1.2 mm on flat areas).

name: casingBackStyle
description: Back follows the plaster offset in sectors, or a flat-walled block (more plaster, simpler parts).

name: casingBasePlate
description: Thickness of the base pattern plate under the working-face positive.

name: casingRingSectors
description: Sectors for full-revolve casing rings (2 allowed with a warning).

name: casingDraftWarnDeg
description: Warn if any casing part has less release draft against the plaster.

name: casingDraftFailDeg
description: Fail below this casing release draft.

name: pourOpenConeDeg
description: Back faces within this angle of up are left open as the screeded pour face.

name: casingFreeboard
description: Casing wall height above the plaster fill line.

name: fillLineDepth
description: Deboss depth of the fill line inside the walls.

name: casingPanelDeflectionMax
description: Allowed panel bulge under slurry head; drives the span check and rib insertion.

name: casingMaterial
description: Casing filament; switched to PETG by the thermal rule.

name: flangeThickness
description: Flange thickness (two flanges = 6 mm fits 25 mm binder clips or the printed clip).

name: flangeWidth
description: Flange width: ridge zone plus clamp jaw depth.

name: ridgeWidth
description: Flange ridge (tongue) width.

name: ridgeHeight
description: Flange ridge height.

name: ridgeInset
description: Distance from the plaster-facing edge to the ridge.

name: seamClearance
description: Ridge/groove clearance per side; calibrate by coupon.

name: grooveBottomGap
description: Extra groove depth so flange faces bear instead of the ridge.

name: leadInChamfer
description: 45 deg lead-in on ridges, grooves and bed edges.

name: sealMethod
description: External seam seal; foamGasket adds a channel with hard stops.

name: clampStyle
description: Clamp type; printed wedge clips are generated as bodies.

name: clampSpacingMax
description: Maximum spacing between clamps along a seam.

name: clampEndOffset
description: Maximum distance from a seam end to the first clamp.

name: clipTaper
description: Wedge taper of the printed C-clip (self-locking).

name: clipInterference
description: Interference per arm when the clip is seated.

name: clipArmThickness
description: Arm thickness of the printed clip.

name: clipWidth
description: Width of the printed clip along the seam.

name: binderClipSize
description: Commercial binder clip size when clampStyle = binderClip (9 mm capacity).

name: mixWaterTempC
description: Planned mix-water temperature; drives the thermal check.

name: shopTempMaxC
description: Highest expected room temperature during pours.

name: plasterPeakMeasuredC
description: Measured peak from the first thermocouple log; overrides the model.

name: bedX
description: Printer bed X limit.

name: bedY
description: Printer bed Y limit.

name: bedZ
description: Printer height limit.

name: nozzleDiameter
description: Nozzle width; walls are snapped to multiples of it.

name: layerFine
description: Layer height for working-face parts (base plates).

name: layerDraft
description: Layer height for walls, sectors and clips.

name: exportFormat
description: Export format, one file per body.

name: exportSurfaceDeviation
description: Mesh surface deviation for export.

name: exportNormalDeviation
description: Mesh normal deviation for export.

name: seamCouponClearances
description: Clearances printed on the groove calibration coupon (mm per side).

name: natchCouponClearances
description: Natch clearances tested with two mini-casings (mm radial).
